task_specification.objective: Eliminate release provenance drift and deliver a native-qualification-ready dense combat surface with complete ordinary reward-attraction and enemy-vitality feedback across Result and Retry.

diagnosis.root_cause: The release ledger and Credits traversal publish a manually hard-coded predecessor SHA-256 instead of the finalized shipped ASSET_PROVENANCE.json digest. Separately, dense qualification lacks a complete native 3/5/10/18/32 matrix and three qualifying ordinary Retry cycles. The candidate already contains preserved reward and vitality mechanisms, but this iteration must concretely complete and lifecycle-bind their entire player-visible behavior—including pickup audio—while retaining bounded dense ownership.

stop_conditions: Do not claim dense performance from llvmpipe, a viewport below 1920x1080, diagnostic setup alone, an incomplete density matrix, or fewer than three distinct ordinary Result-to-Retry cycles.
If ASSET_PROVENANCE.json changes after digest binding, stop release handoff and recompute/rebind the finalized digest.

Preserve the accepted camera, cemetery, HUD, weapons, reward presentation, vitality presentation, and bounded ownership mechanisms; stop before replacing those families without new package-level incompatibility evidence.
All validation preparation actions must remain editor-only, physically unbound, generation-checked, separate from advancement, and absent from release exports.
Developer stops after candidate implementation and focused self-validation; GameLoop Runtime and Tester own native capture, formal verdicts, issue closure, and phase closure.

strategy.rationale: Use two ownership-level repairs instead of another evidence-only pass: bind all release provenance publication to one finalized manifest truth, and make dense profiling exercise the complete player-facing reward, vitality, audio, and Retry lifecycles through authoritative owner maps and explicit native qualification records.

code: Parse and boot the native Godot project with no GDScript, resource, or recurring runtime errors.
Compute the finalized ASSET_PROVENANCE.json SHA-256 and verify the stale predecessor digest is absent while both publication paths resolve to the current value.

Exercise candidate-owned checks for stale setup generations, incomplete density matrices, software-renderer rejection, duplicate reward identities, actor-generation vitality retirement, and three-cycle growth rejection.
